note.title: Education and work
note.specFocus: School subjects, timetables, rules, teachers, exams, homework, plans after school, careers, part-time jobs, work experience, and future ambitions.
note.sourcePages: Original GCSE Spanish revision material; it is not an official AQA paper, mark scheme, or copied publisher content.
note.summary:
Education and work

Key vocabulary
- las asignaturas; aprobar/suspender; las normas; los deberes; el horario; la carrera; el sueldo; las prácticas laborales; solicitar empleo; a tiempo parcial; el jefe; la universidad; tener éxito

Key grammar
- Use me gusta(n) with a singular or plural subject. Use hay que/tener que for obligation, the preterite for completed school events, the imperfect for primary-school routines, and future/conditional for ambitions.

Exam tips
- Use aprobar (to pass) rather than pasar. Do not confuse la carrera with un empleo. In translations, keep job nouns gender-appropriate and omit the article after ser where normal.

questions.examTip: Build a short description, an opinion with porque and a personal or hypothetical comment.
questions.modelAnswer:
En la foto se ven alumnos de distintos grupos que colaboran en un laboratorio. Las personas parecen concentradas y de buen humor. A mi parecer, esta situación es positiva porque muestra algo importante sobre tu educación y tu futuro profesional. Además, me gustaría participar porque sería una experiencia útil y memorable.

(English: In the photo I can see students from different classes collaborating in a laboratory. The people seem focused and in good spirits. In my opinion, this situation is positive because it shows something important about the topic. I would also like to take part because it would be useful and memorable.)

questions.examTip: Cover all bullets and keep speaking; an opinion plus reason is better than a long but unfinished sentence.
questions.modelAnswer:
— Mi asignatura favorita es el dibujo porque puedo expresar mis ideas. A mi modo de ver es importante porque tiene ventajas para mí y para otras personas. — (Unexpected question) Trabajo en una cafetería los sábados y gano ocho euros por hora.

(English: — My favourite subject is art because I can express my ideas. In my view it is important because it has benefits for me and other people. — I work in a café on Saturdays and earn eight euros an hour.)
